journey.title: Our Journey Of Success
journey.subtitle: From Humble Beginnings To Global Leadership
journey.item_founded_desc: Golden Sun Export was founded with a clear vision: to carry the quality of Egyptian agriculture beyond borders.
journey.item_gcc_desc: Golden Sun built its early export experience and established trust across GCC markets.
journey.item_europe_desc: Building on its GCC experience, Golden Sun expanded its ambition toward European markets.
journey.item_today_desc: Golden Sun currently serves the Netherlands, United Kingdom and GCC markets, with continued ambition to expand internationally.

why_choose.banner_text: We combine real production access, real packing operations and a clear export journey.
why_choose.item1_desc: Farm, harvest, packing station, pallets and container loading are all documented with real photos.
why_choose.item2_desc: Cartons, crates, mesh bags and retail trays can be prepared according to buyer needs.
why_choose.item3_desc: Products are sorted, selected and packed according to export-market expectations.
why_choose.item4_desc: From GCC markets to the Netherlands and the United Kingdom, Golden Sun continues to expand.
why_choose.benefits_subtitle: How Golden Sun delivers tangible value across cost, time, quality and supply risk
why_choose.benefit_cost_desc: Direct sourcing from farms & competitive stable pricing to optimize purchasing cost.
why_choose.benefit_time_desc: 24H proforma response, rapid phytosanitary clearance and timely reefer delivery.
why_choose.benefit_quality_desc: Consistent high caliber produce, optical sorting and calibrated packaging.
why_choose.benefit_risk_desc: Complete batch traceability and reduced compliance and supply risk.
why_choose.benefit_growth_desc: Reliable seasonal export partnerships supporting your business expansion.

certificates_section.title: International Quality & Food Safety Accreditations
certificates_section.subtitle: Certified compliance for European, British and Global export markets
certificates_section.cert1_desc: Good Agricultural Practices ensuring chemical residue compliance (MRL), environmental safety, and sustainable farming.
certificates_section.cert2_desc: Social practice compliance and ethical labor standards across all harvesting and packing operations.
certificates_section.cert3_desc: Supplier Ethical Data Exchange audit certification for continuous ethical, social, and environmental supply chain transparency.
certificates_section.cert4_desc: Global Standard for Food Safety accreditation verifying advanced packhouse hygiene, automated sorting, and HACCP process controls.
